label: Bible Study
prompt: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth _____ unto her.
verse: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clave unto her.
note: Two daughters-in-law, two choices — Orpah kisses goodbye, Ruth clings and won't let go.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: When thou hast eaten and art _____, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
verse: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
note: Eat, be full, then bless God for the good land — gratitude on a full stomach.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he commanded them to make all sit down by _____ upon the green grass.
verse: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
note: Before feeding the five thousand, Jesus had everyone sit in companies on the green grass — crowd control, picnic style.

label: Deep Water
prompt: In whom we have _____ through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
verse: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
note: Redemption was the language of buying back a slave or captive — Paul names the price: his blood.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Beautiful for _____, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
verse: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
note: 'Beautiful for situation' — Zion praised for its setting, the KJV's stately way of saying 'great location.'
